summary: Iter3 (frontend-only) — Validated the two new changes in PAUSE: (1) new compact-expandable 'Argomenti attivi' element in Home and (2) new 3D holo-v1c category icons. All target testIDs render and work on 390x844: home-active-topics-toggle, home-active-plus (+1 with 4 topics), home-active-topics-title, home-active-topics-body, home-active-mini-{scienza|spazio|natura}, and chevron (visible). Tap expands the body in-place (bbox height 0→290) and tap again collapses it (height 290→0). Expanded grid shows home-cat-{scienza|spazio|natura|animali} with the holo 3D images (home-category-art-{id}-image). Toggle flow: tapping a tile toggles its selection; turning off the last remaining active category triggers home-min-one-toast ('Keep at least one category active'). 3D icons: on Home (grid open) and on Topics (/(tabs)/explore) all images load — 25 images on Home, 40 images on Topics screen, 0 broken, no line-icon fallback element is instantiated (category-art-{id}-fallback not present when image is loaded). Resume card: no reading progress yet → correctly absent (resume-reading-card not rendered), as per spec. App language in web preview is English (I18n defaults from browser locale), but all target testIDs are language-independent. No red screens, console shows only pre-existing warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents, Reanimated web easing).
critical_code_review_comments: home-active-topics.tsx uses an outer View height=openH wrapping ScrollView; naturalH vs maxH=winH*0.44 correctly caps panel height and enables internal scroll with nestedScrollEnabled — good; no overlap with bottom tab bar observed with 4 topics.
discover.tsx toggleCat correctly guards against disabling the last active id and shows the min-one toast via showMinOneToast(); works end-to-end.
category-artwork.tsx CategoryArtMark falls back to CategoryIcon on image onError — fallback did not trigger on holo-v1c, so icons render crisply with saturated colors.
ResumeCard is only mounted when showResume && resume (progress<0.95). Verified it does not appear for a fresh guest user — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all tested flows (compact bar, expand/collapse, toggle, min-one toast, 3D icons on Home+Topics, resume-card absence)

seed_data_creation: Fresh guest user via onboarding (continue-as-guest + 4 selected topics scienza/spazio/natura/animali). No backend seeds beyond what onboarding creates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). To reach Home from fresh session: tap [data-testid="onboarding-profile-continue"] (Continue as guest), then click 2-4 [data-testid="category-art-{id}"] tiles, then [data-testid="onboarding-continue"]. Home testIDs for Argomenti attivi: home-active-topics (container), home-active-topics-toggle (tap to expand), home-active-topics-title, home-active-plus (+N when categories.length>3), home-active-mini-{id} (first 3 previews), home-active-topics-body (collapses to height 0 when closed), home-cat-{id} (tiles in expanded grid). Toast: home-min-one-toast + home-min-one-toast-text. 3D artwork image: category-art-{id}-image (onboarding/explore) and home-category-art-{id}-image (home grid); fallback testID is category-art-{id}-fallback / home-category-art-{id}-fallback (does NOT render while image loads successfully). The web preview locale defaults to English — testIDs do not depend on locale.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all probed functionality works as specified.
